name: Παραλία Καλλιθέας (Oasis)
evidence: Rhodes Kallithea/Oasis (lat 36.375, coast S of Rhodes town): sources state 'Oasis Beach features a rocky beach rather than sandy' with sculpted rocks and micro-coves; matches our βράχια and OSM ROCKS.

name: Παραλία Φούρνοι
evidence: Fourni below Monolithos, SW Rhodes (lat 36.106): 'covered with golden brown sand which turns a bit stony near the water, a significant portion is pebbled, but sandy patches can also be found' — sand+pebble mix, not pure sand as our label and OSM claim.

name: Σύμη Γυάλα
evidence: Symi (lat 36.62): island beaches 'almost all have pebbles and little or no sand'; consistent with our βότσαλα and OSM PEBBLES for this Symi cove.

name: ΠΔΕ Καστελόκαμπος
evidence: Kastelokampos by the Rio bridge, Achaia (lat 38.29, lng 21.77): 'a mix of golden sand and pebbles ... continuous strip of sand and pebbles ~1.2km' — mixed, not the pebbles-only of our label and OSM.

name: Kitesurf Spot
evidence: Kite spot on the SE coastal section of Nafpaktos near Grimbovo (lat 38.38, lng 21.85); the Nafpaktos shoreline here is fine-pebble/gravel, matching our βότσαλα and OSM PEBBLES.

name: Ασπρογιάλι
evidence: Asprogiali 7km from Astakos toward Vonitsa (lat 38.54, lng 21.01): 'Η παραλία είναι βοτσαλωτή' (pebbly) — contradicts our άμμος and OSM SAND.

name: Γρίμποβο
evidence: Gribovo in Nafpaktos (lat 38.39, lng 21.835): 'coarse sand and pebbles, with velvety sand ... pebbles dotting the water's edge' — mixed, not pebbles-only as our label/OSM say.

name: Παραλία Κανάλι
evidence: Coords (lat 38.44, lng 21.35) sit in the Kryoneri/Kato Vasiliki stretch of Nafpaktia (Kryoneri = 'fine-pebbled and sandy'), but no source specifically identifies a beach named 'Κανάλι' here to confirm composition; keep current label.

name: Παραλία Κουλούρι
evidence: Koulouri at Sparto on the Ambrakian Gulf, Amfilochia (lat 38.91, lng 21.11) is confirmed as an existing swimming beach, but no source states its sand/pebble composition; keep current άμμος label.

name: Παραλία Ρούγας
evidence: Rouga cove near Paliambela on the S Ambrakian Gulf (lat 38.92, lng 21.00): 'a pebbly beach and deeply shaded trees' — contradicts our άμμος and OSM SAND.

name: Πλαζ Ναυπάκτου
evidence: Psani plage W of Nafpaktos harbor (lat 38.39, lng 21.827): 'continuous strip of fine pebbles extends ~1.7km ... also has sandy areas' — fine-pebble predominant, matching our βότσαλα and OSM PEBBLES (some sand present).

name: Αλόννησος Μηλιά
evidence: Milia (not Chrysi Milia) on Alonissos (lat 39.16): 'there are large pebbles at first, while deeper into the water there is sand' — pebble shore, matching our βότσαλα and OSM PEBBLES.

name: Ξάνεμο
evidence: Xanemos by Skiathos airport (lat 39.19, lng 23.51): 'coarse grey sand mixed with pebbles ... a line of shingle around the water's edge' — mixed, not pure sand as our label and OSM claim.

name: Άγιος Ιωάννης
evidence: Agios Ioannis Kastri (Mamma Mia chapel), NW Skopelos (lat 39.17, lng 23.65): 'a narrow pebble beach ... combination of sand, pebbles and small rocks' — predominantly pebble/rock, not sand as our label and OSM claim.

name: Στάφυλος
evidence: Stafylos, 4km S of Skopelos town (lat 39.09, lng 23.75): 'mixed pebbles with fine gray sand ... a delightful mix of golden sand and smooth pebbles' — sand+pebble mix, not pebbles-only as our label/OSM say.

name: Άγιος Ιωάννης
evidence: Agios Ioannis, Pelion/Zagora (lat 39.417, lng 23.16): 'built on a unique sandy area with white pearl-like pebbles', longest organized beach in Magnesia — sand+pebble, definitely not the βράχια/ROCKS our label and OSM claim.

name: Άγιος Ιωάννης (Ζαγορά)
evidence: Same beach as id 2670 (lat 39.418, lng 23.16), Agios Ioannis Pelion: 'sandy area with white pearl-like pebbles' — sand+pebble, not βράχια/ROCKS as our label and OSM claim.

name: Αγιά Θυμιά
evidence: Agia Thymia, S Pelion Pagasitic coast near Afissos/Lefokastro (lat 39.26, lng 23.18): 'a spacious pebbly cove, wild, with no amenities' (sandy seafloor) — pebble surface, not sand as our label and OSM claim.
